The series was announced by E! on May 4, 2017. The series is the second spin-off of WAGS. The show is set in Atlanta and will document the personal and professional lives of a group of WAGs.[2][4][5] WAGS Atlanta premiered on January 3, 2018.[6]. The series had three spin-off shows, all on the E! network: WAGS Miami (2016–2017), which ran for two seasons,[4][5] WAGS Atlanta (2018), which ran for one season,[5][6] and Relatively Nat & Liv (2019), starring Olivia Pierson and Natalie Halcro of WAGS LA, which ran for one season.[7][8].
